overview: A federal judge ordered President Trump to sit for a deposition in his defamation lawsuit against the BBC. The U.S. Embassy in Canada alleged potential election interference following tariff disputes. Meanwhile, a 152-unit housing project in San Francisco's Mission District is finally breaking ground with reduced community benefits. In Hawaii, the Honolulu Police Department is reassigning officers amid hundreds of vacancies, and residents served by a storm-damaged private water system seek to take it over.

items.title: Trump ordered to sit for deposition in $10 billion BBC lawsuit
items.summary: A federal judge ordered President Trump to sit for a Dec. 11 deposition in his $10 billion defamation lawsuit against the BBC.

items.title: 152-unit Mission District project to break ground—with shrunken promises
items.summary: A developer is breaking ground on a 152-unit housing project in the Mission District after previous agreements for community benefits expired.

items.title: HPD staffing reassignments come amid 453 officer vacancies
items.summary: The Honolulu Police Department is reassigning officers to patrol districts while working to fill 453 uniformed and 182 civilian vacancies.

items.title: With Their Taps Dry For 9 Weeks And Counting, They Want To Take Over
items.summary: Residents in Punalu'u want to take over a private water system whose taps have been dry for nine weeks following Hurricane Lala.

items.title: ‘Sadistic’ Cult: Hilo High Schooler Preyed On Girls Online
items.summary: Federal investigators report that a Hilo high schooler targeted vulnerable young girls online amid a rise in violent extremism.
